input.command: python3 -c 'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; from pathlib import Path; p="data/crashes.parquet"; out=Path("out"); df=duckdb.connect().execute("SELECT YEAR(crash_date) AS year, SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrians_killed FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= ? AND crash_date < ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", [p, "2013-01-01", "2026-01-01"]).df(); df["year"]=df["year"].astype(int); df["pedestrians_killed"]=df["pedestrians_killed"].astype(int); assert df.year.tolist()==list(range(2013,2026)); df.to_csv(out/"values_1.csv",index=False); df.to_csv(out/"values_2.csv",index=False); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.5)); bars=ax.bar(df.year.astype(str),df.pedestrians_killed,color="#2676a5"); ax.bar_label(bars,padding=3,fontsize=8); ax.set(title="Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes by year",xlabel="Crash year",ylabel="Pedestrians killed"); ax.set_ylim(0, max(df.pedestrians_killed)*1.17); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_1.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.5)); ax.plot(df.year,df.pedestrians_killed,marker="o",linewidth=2,color="#2676a5"); ax.set_xticks(df.year); ax.set_xticklabels(df.year,rotation=0); ax.set(title="Annual trend in pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes",xlabel="Crash year",ylabel="Pedestrians killed"); ax.set_ylim(0,max(df.pedestrians_killed)*1.17); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); [ax.annotate(str(v),(x,v),xytext=(0,7),textcoords="offset points",ha="center",fontsize=8) for x,v in zip(df.year,df.pedestrians_killed)]; fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_2.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig); print(df.to_string(index=False)); print("selected rows",duckdb.connect().execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= ? AND crash_date < ?",[p,"2013-01-01","2026-01-01"]).fetchone()[0])'
